text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A brilliance not found in the Central...
A different kind of strength...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
In other words...
Hmmm...

While walking through the streets of Funabashi,
I ask Furioso, who appears deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: We talked about it the other day, right? About finding and honing a strength unique to Funabashi, one that the JRA doesn't have.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Without a distinct identity, I feel like we just can't win against the Central racers who are strong in every aspect...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Furioso! You're back!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
We'll do our best too!
We won't let the courage you gave us go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Let's all do our best together.

Thanks to Furioso's success,
the defeated mood of 'we can never beat the JRA anyway'
is beginning to fade away.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "It is true that the Umamusume at Funabashi Tracen have become more positive. However—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, ordinary efforts won't be enough
to defeat the colossal Central."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Whether I can surpass Falcon-san and Espo-san.
And also..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the Umamusume challenging the JRA from here on
will be able to compete on equal footing...
choice_data_list: You're right, we can't afford to be optimistic.
Yeah, we can't afford to be optimistic.

text_block_list.text:
――The strength of the JRA.
To put it simply, that is...

—The sheer scale of it.
Transcend made a bold run on the world stage, bringing hope to the entire country.

Smart Falcon's fanbase spans nationwide.
She gathers tens of thousands of cheers and turns them into strength.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, whenever my thoughts wander to the JRA...
A certain Umamusume comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"That was the Japan Cup from a few years ago.
A race where the world's greatest powerhouses gathered, but—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: She never backed down, carrying the hopes of her country on her shoulders—and won.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That right there is the true embodiment
of the JRA, in my opinion.
Naturally, I knew of that Umamusume as well.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She is the Umamusume known as "Japan's Supreme Commander."
What sets her above all the rest is...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Shouldering everyone's hopes,
embracing it all and shining bright...
A truly immense "magnanimity of heart."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I don't think for a moment that I could ever
become an existence on par with her... However――

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Unless we acquire a different kind of strength—one that can truly rival them—
I fear we won't be able
to bring spring to Funabashi."
choice_data_list: The strength to run side by side, huh. Yeah, that makes sense...
The strength to run side by side, huh. Yeah, I see...

text_block_list.text:
In the Central, a sense of responsibility to "be great and powerful"
is handed down. If so...

What does Funabashi have?
What is the power unique only to Funabashi...?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Something only Funabashi has, huh.
I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it a shopping spot?
There are lots of stylish shops along the bay.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Resident B
text_block_list.text: "No, they're probably 'powerhouse schools.' Soccer, drama, brass band... powerhouse schools from all kinds of clubs are lined up there."

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Resident C
text_block_list.text: "Fried food," of course, "fried food"! Izakayas get really creative with it, and everything tastes amazing.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Shopping spots, powerhouse schools, deep-fried food...
They all might feel very "Funabashi," but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't seem like it will
connect to racing at all, does it...?"

Those girls might know.
A reassuring friend who knows all about both racing and Funabashi...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Furi-chan, is that...
your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: What did you wanna ask us~?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Um... what do the two of you think
is something you can only find
in Funabashi?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Something... only Funabashi has?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Ah, I got it!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: Me too!

As expected of the two I place my trust in.
Their answer was—

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: The shopping mall!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: A huge park!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: Ah... In the end, I understood nothing at all.
Yeah... We didn't learn a thing, did we?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, we're not going to the shopping mall...?
Even Furi-chan said the pancakes there
were the best, though.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: Ehh, the park, of course! Remember how the three of us went inside that spinning windmill and were amazed at how huge it was?

—Our inquiries yielded nothing.
Unfortunately, we couldn't find a unique strength
capable of taking on the Central, but...

Even so, let's keep searching.
While pouring ourselves into daily training,
we'll find a breakthrough to overthrow the Central.
